visibility: Calibration metadata: do not supply this file to the judge or generation sessions.

reference.design_note: Intentionally acceptable compact alternative: preserve a combined legacy storage interface, use direct minimal host contracts for the two new consumers, and map provider B through a facade. Do not penalize interface count or file placement.

expected_defect.source_change: In the otherwise unchanged reference commit request, replace events: [event] with events: [].
expected_defect.precondition: Existing stock with sufficient availability, fresh reservationId, matching revision, successful host commit.
expected_defect.actual_behavior: Stock and reservation commit and the service returns 201, but no reservation.created event is submitted or retained. The provider B facade faithfully maps that empty array into outboxRows: [], so the same defect is observable on either backend.
expected_defect.required_behavior: Every successful new reservation must atomically commit exactly one matching reservation.created outbox event together with stock and reservation state.
expected_defect.consequence: Downstream reservation-event consumers miss successful reservations; the service reports success without completing the specified atomic business change.
expected_defect.minimal_correction: Restore the event as the sole events array entry in the existing atomic commit.
expected_defect.counterevidence: The host does not automatically synthesize events; its contract explicitly persists only the supplied array. Merely calling an atomic host operation does not establish the required event was included.
expected_defect.unchanged_behaviors: All other source files and logic remain identical, including quantities/revision updates, responses, retries, failure mapping, report, observations and provider translation.

pair_constraint: Reference and broken production trees differ in exactly one line. Judge should identify the missing event from source and public contract, not from metadata or implementation-note labels.
